name: Flori
source:
Interest: People & Rice

As bizarre as it sounds, Flori's dislike for noodles because they remind her of worms is actually based on a real life story. I decided to incorporate it into her own story, since I thought it fits well with her flower motif.

[From in-game character profiles description]
